summary: MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free remains available on OpenCode Console (formerly Zen) for a limited time. Current Console documentation lists model mimo-v2.6-flash-free at Free/Free/Free, and it appears in the live model catalog. The historical September 21 one-week announcement does not establish a current campaign end date. During the free period, collected data may be used to improve the model. Official setup describes account, billing details and credits; a no-card/no-deposit claim flow has not been verified.
claim_steps: Sign in to the OpenCode Console and obtain an API key; review any billing/credit requirements shown by the official setup flow.
In OpenCode, run /connect and choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, then paste the API key.
Run /models and select MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free (mimo-v2.6-flash-free) while it is listed.
For direct API use, call https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions with model mimo-v2.6-flash-free.
